nameOrigin: the girl in the poem 'Mary Had a Little Lamb'

pokedexEntries.go: If static electricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.

pokedexEntries.si: Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.

pokedexEntries.cr: It stores lots of air in its soft fur, allowing it to stay cool in summer and warm in winter.

pokedexEntries.rs: MAREEP’s fluffy coat of wool rubs together and builds a static charge. The more static electricity is charged, the more brightly the lightbulb at the tip of its tail grows.
